items: 3 USB Ports & 2 AC Outlets - All-in-One Under Desk Headset Stand with Charging Station features 2 AC outlets (800W) and 3 USB ports (1 USB-C, 2 USB-A) to power your phone, iPad or other smart devices at once.

360° Rotating Dual Hooks with Cable Holes - The gaming headset stand with 360° swivel lets you adjust directions easily and hang multiple headphones effortlessly. Multiple cable holes on the hooks hold your cables in place, keeping your gaming/office desk tidy. Tuck the hooks neatly under your desk when not in use for space-saving storage.

Firm & Stylish - The headphone stand is crafted from high-quality alloy and high-grade ABS material, keeping it stable, firm and secure. It won’t fall off even when holding items for a long time, balancing reliability with a sleek look.

Universal Fit - This headset stand works with nearly all wireless/wired headphones (e.g., AirPods Max, HyperX) and fits all sizes, a must-have gaming desk accessory. It also holds hats, umbrellas, or game controllers, fitting neatly on kitchen counters or bookshelves.

Easy Installation with Dual Fixing Methods - This headphone stand includes high-strength stickers and screw holes: tear off the sticker to stick it under your desk effortlessly (no complicated operations), or use screws for extra sturdiness. It fits perfectly on kitchen counters, bookshelves, studios, offices, glass surfaces, and desktops for versatile use.
